data.gender_notes: Buhran is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'buhara', meaning 'to rain abundantly'. Buhran symbolizes a rich and prosperous life. The name Buhran carries the meaning “Fruitful, prosperous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Buhran usually hope their child will grow to embody fruitful, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name Buhran represents a sense of abundance and prosperity in life. This name may resonate particularly with those living in regions that experience extensive rainfall, as the name symbolizes the joy and abundance that comes with a good rain. Additionally, in many Islamic cultures, the name may be given to a child born during a time of abundant rain or agricultural prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: At a deeper spiritual level, the name Buhran carries the idea of God's blessings and mercy showering upon us in abundance. The name serves as a reminder that no matter the circumstances of our lives, there is always potential for growth and renewal, just as the earth is rejuvenated by rain. This name also encourages us to be grateful for the blessings in our lives and to appreciate the abundance that comes from God's provision.
